sessions.title: 👋 Welcome to Day 1!
sessions.text: Hi there! I'm Luna. Are you ready for today’s adventure? Let’s go!

sessions.title: 🧘 Let’s Breathe Together!
sessions.text: Breathe in... and out... Let’s do it three times together.

sessions.title: 🔢 Let’s Count with Animals!
sessions.text: Say the numbers out loud and meet a new animal with each one!

sessions.title: 🎵 Rhyme Time!
sessions.text: Brush your teeth and make them shine...

sessions.title: 🐾 Guess the Animal!
sessions.text: What animal do you see today? Let’s find out together!

sessions.title: 📖 Story Time with Luna
sessions.text: Let’s hear a short story to end our day!
